summary: You can now work through your repository’s GitHub code scanning alerts without leaving the GitHub Copilot app. The new GitHub security extension, now in public preview, lets you find the alerts that matter most and ask Copilot to explain or help fix them.
takeaways: For Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise, an administrator needs to enable the GitHub Copilot app policy, and can use enterprise managed settings to control which plugins developers can install.
The new GitHub security extension, now in public preview, lets you find the alerts that matter most and ask Copilot to explain or help fix them.
Copilot uses the security extension’s tools in the same way as any other tool, following your tool permission settings.
